name: ETF Project 1: Build a Stand and Three-Bay Organizer
description: Build a card stand, then a three-bay supply tray; measure fit and improve one tested feature. Core strands: trades math, measuring, and drawing/plan interpretation.

name: ETF Project 2: Build and Test a Model Community Room
description: Build the supplied 16 × 12-ft community room at 1/2 in = 1 ft, with a working door and removable roof. Test structural shapes and insulation. Core strands: trades math, measuring, and drawing/plan interpretation.

name: ETF Project 3: Build a Syringe-Powered Delivery Sled
description: Build one water-powered delivery sled: a hand syringe moves a second syringe and an attached card sled along a marked track. Core strands: trades math, measuring, and drawing/plan interpretation.

name: ETF Project 4: Wire a Door Signal and Two-Room Lighting
description: Build a 3-V door-open signal and two-room model with independently switched lamps. Trace, test and repair the actual connections. Core strands: trades math, measuring, and drawing/plan interpretation.
